pairs.target: tǎ wéi chāixìn shí zhèngzài chī zǎofàn , gǎnjǐn jiāng wǎn nuó yuǎn , réng yǒu yìxiǎo diǎntāng luò zài jiǎo shàng , kànzhe xiàng píngkōng duōchū le yìkē dīng .

pairs.target: xìn lǐ shuō , duǎn xiē de bǐng bìng bú zìdòng shěnglì . tā tóng sū yǐ gǎi le bǐng zǒuguò de húxiàn , ràng shǒuwàn búbì niǔ dào mòwěi , zài qǐng shàng huí shìyòng de rén lái zuōfang shì .

pairs.target: " wǒmen hái méi dāying . " mǐlā zài xìn lǐ xiě , " sū yǐ shuō nǐ yì tīngjiàn néng zuò , jiù wàng le rénjiā dàodǐ wèn de shénme . wǒ juéde tā zài shuō wǒ . tā shuō shì de . "
pairs.english: “We haven't agreed yet,” Mira wrote. “Suyi says the moment you hear you can do something, you forget what people actually asked. I felt she meant me. She said yes.”

pairs.english: Tavi laughed aloud. Ruan Heng looked up from the next table, so he read the passage to him, laughing again at the end.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑出了声。阮衡从隔桌抬头，他便把这一段念给他听，念到最后自己又笑了一次。

pairs.hanzi: 米拉还说回校谈实作的那天自己也要到，若塔维能带点风栈吃的，别再带只能煮不能生嚼的东西。

pairs.english: Tavi had been doing ordinary measurements these past days. After seven days, it was finally time to use again the new lever position Instructor Vey's letter permitted.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这几日一直做普通测量，隔了七天，才轮到再用维老师信里准许的那种新杠杆位置。

pairs.english: Permission covered only this contact exercise; Mira's two drawings weren't leave to build another object and try property borrowing on it.
pairs.hanzi: 许可只管这套接触练习，不能照着米拉的两张图，便另外搭一件东西试借性。

pairs.hanzi: 两块铁仍是原来核过整块体积的那一对。阮衡先查固定、轻载和止挡，塔维将两边未借时的数读给他听。

pairs.hanzi: 塔维将手放上去，先不动，等呼吸缓下来。刚读信时的笑意还留着，他试着压掉，脑中却反而全是那根短柄。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méi cuī , zài pángbiān fān dào kòngbái yíyè , děng tā tái yǎn cái wèn yào buyào zài děng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng didn't hurry him, turning to a blank page beside him and waiting until Tavi looked up to ask if he needed more time.

pairs.english: “I was thinking how Mira turns that handle,” Tavi said. “I'm ready now.”

等轻载读数都回到原来的位置，才抬手。
卸下轻载后又查了一回，没有留下变化。

pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐到窗边歇眼，嘴角却翘着。

pairs.target: nàzhǒng gāoxìng hěn nán xiàng chǐcùn yíyàng xiě qīng : búshì hūrán néng jiè gèng duō , érshì fāngcái nàme xiǎo de yìdiǎn , tā méiyǒu jí zhe bǎ tā diūdiào , yě méiyǒu fēi yào biérén kànchū yǒu duō liǎobùqǐ .

pairs.english: Only after these did he include his pleasure in the two contact exercises, without presenting it as an ability to adjust an entire water apparatus for her already.

pairs.english: Before the mail cart collected its bags, he paid to post the reply. Back in his room he saw the two drawings still lying flat on his table.

pairs.english: The soup spot had dried and really did look like a nail; he lightly circled it and noted that it wasn't part of the drawing.
